limitations:
This has not been executed. It assumes the constructor's domain:
- k is between 3 and 5.
- The motif-edge line (canonical row 0) never has an erased dash, so k is read from the first separator pixel there.
- Grey does not appear inside cells.
- The bottom paint strip holds only paint colours, background, and possibly separators.
- The palette maps colours bijectively.

If no separator is found, it returns the input unchanged as a fallback. Position maps are disjoint in the generator, so stamping order never matters. If they overlapped, later middle columns would overwrite earlier ones, matching the archived solver. I found no contradictions between the fixtures and the rule.
